name: Southern East Madagascar Current
scope: OSW offshore reference corridor for the southern branch along eastern Madagascar, from approximately20S to the offshore Cape Sainte Marie approach. Exact offshore vertices and the southern25.8S approach are editorial choices, not observed core positions or exact source-defined current endpoints. Excludes northern branch, undercurrent, rings, SICC and uncertain downstream continuations into the Mozambique Channel or Agulhas system.
layer: Upper-current contextual geography; no fixed-depth or velocity-derived axis reconstructed. Excludes the equatorward undercurrent.
time_convention: Undated contextual geography described by Nauw et al.2008, citing earlier studies; not an April2001 axis, seasonal state, annual mean or operational position.
source_locator: Introduction paragraph2: southward flow along eastern Madagascar between approximately20S and Cape Sainte Marie near25deg30minS; paragraph6: unresolved downstream alternatives. Original publisher HTML inspected; no source figure or station coordinates digitized.
source_citation: Nauw, van Aken, Webb, Lutjeharms and de Ruijter (2008), Observations of the southern East Madagascar Current and undercurrent and countercurrent system, Journal of Geophysical Research113,C08006, doi:10.1029/2007JC004639.
source_license: Original OSW factual paraphrase and editorial vertices; no publication, figure, station data or provider geometry redistributed.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects offshore coastal vertices and a southern Cape approach. Common longitude and independent endpoint latitude shifts are predeclared cartographic sensitivities, not observed current boundaries, errors or seasonal excursions.
